commitResults.messageBody: Extract UI, storage, parsing, and task-list responsibilities from the main application class. This keeps DisciTrack focused on coordinating the app flow while preserving the existing command behavior.

Introduce a Command abstraction and command-specific classes for add, list, mark, unmark, checkdate, delete, and bye. Parser now converts user input directly into executable command objects, allowing DisciTrack to focus on the main application loop and reducing command-specific branching in the coordinator.

Move command, task, parser, storage, UI, and exception classes into dedicated discitrack subpackages. This keeps the root package focused on the main application class while grouping related classes by responsibility.

commitResults.messageTitle: Polish DisciTrack with a coach-inspired GUI
commitResults.messageBody:
The messenger-style layout makes task output hard to scan and leaves
DisciTrack's coaching personality mostly confined to its header.

Introduce a responsive coach's desk with clearer task controls and
feedback while preserving the original logo and typed commands.

- Distinguish compact user commands from titled app response cards.
- Highlight errors with explicit error state and contrasting styling.
- Add an enthusiastic coach portrait, motivational feedback, empty-list
  congratulations, and a subtle silent celebration pulse.
- Add inline search, task creation, mark/unmark, tag/untag, and delete
  controls that use the existing command and persistence logic.
- Show all tasks after creation or list, matching tasks after searches,
  and only the affected task after mark, unmark, tag, or untag.
- Preserve scrollable session history without accumulating task boards.
- Adapt the sidebar, wrapping controls, and content to window resizing.
- Document the GUI behavior and generated coach artwork provenance.

Add a JavaFX integration test covering shared button/command state,
search transitions, original task numbering, tags, deletion, history,
empty-list feedback, and persistence using isolated temporary data.
Skip display-dependent verification on headless machines.

Validation: all 40 tests and Checkstyle pass on Java 25; build the
runnable JAR and review wide and compact GUI snapshots.

The coach's headings and reactions use inconsistent phrasing and heavy
capitalization, while some errors provide too little recovery guidance.

Unify the welcome, task feedback, search results, tag confirmations, and
farewell around a supportive coach with light humor. Keep completion
messages explicit and celebrate progress without confusing the user.

- Apply the agreed wording and express pride in completed tasks.
- Use friendly UHOH/OOPSIE errors with actionable input guidance.
- Distinguish missing, non-numeric, and out-of-range task numbers.
- Add clearer examples for missing descriptions and invalid dates.
- Use sentence case and lighter sidebar text for easier reading while
  retaining bold headings, gold accents, and enthusiastic phrasing.
- Update response assertions to match the approved wording.

Preserve the GUI layout, task operations, and persistence behavior.

Validation: all 40 tests and Checkstyle pass on Java 25; build the
runnable JAR and inspect the updated compact GUI rendering.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve error handling and command recovery
commitResults.messageBody:
Reject missing fields, repeated date markers, unexpected arguments,
reversed event ranges, and descriptions that cannot be stored safely.
Accept tabs between command arguments and retain valid same-day events,
past dates, and duplicate tasks.

Report malformed saved dates with their values and line numbers while
blocking writes to protect existing data. Roll back every modifying
command after a failed save and provide file recovery advice. Report
repeated mark and unmark actions without saving or celebrating again.

Keep invalid form and command input available for correction. Hide stale
task boards after failed commands while preserving inline tag editors.
Add a clear-command button so users can discard a draft easily without
changing tasks or conversation history.

Update the user guide and manual acceptance checklist. Add regression
coverage for invalid input, malformed files, save rollback, form recovery,
task-board visibility, and clearing command drafts.

Validation: all 45 tests, Checkstyle, and shadowJar passed with Java 25.
Inspect GUI snapshots for the clear button and wrapped form errors.

Add tests for task numbering, date boundaries, persistence workflows,
malformed save files, save recovery, invalid task numbers, multilingual
text, and response accuracy.

Report data-driven error scenarios independently and document manual
checks for GUI layouts, keyboard use, OS platforms, display scaling,
and language settings.

Validation: all 148 test cases passed with none skipped, and Checkstyle
passed using Java 25.

Add a quick start, complete command reference, GUI instructions,
realistic examples, error recovery, and storage guidance.
Correct the setup instructions and connect the repository README to the published User Guide. Clarify task controls and numbering while fixing the published Markdown formatting.
